ChannelInfo.title: ChannelInfo
ChannelInfo.description: A channel a plot's server module validates. Server-produced.

ChartTemplate.title: ChartTemplate
ChartTemplate.description: A reusable style preset applied to charts.

Encoding.title: Encoding
Encoding.description: One field bound to a channel. `field` may be None only for count(*).

ImportFromPathRequest.title: ImportFromPathRequest
ImportFromPathRequest.description: Local mode only: read a file in place instead of uploading it.

ImportOptions.title: ImportOptions
ImportOptions.description: Overrides for auto-detection. Leave a field unset to let the reader detect it.

LayoutItem.title: LayoutItem
LayoutItem.description: One widget placed on the 12-column grid (react-grid-layout units).

RangePredicate.title: RangePredicate
RangePredicate.description: Numeric range, or date range when op is `between_dates`. A missing bound is open.

SeriesStyle.title: SeriesStyle
SeriesStyle.description: Per-series overrides, keyed by index into the y channel.

SortKey.title: SortKey
SortKey.description: One sort key, shared by the sort step, grid rows, pipeline previews and exports.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: Points at the data a chart, pipeline step or widget reads.

Trendline.title: Trendline
Trendline.description: A server-computed overlay fitted to one y series.

ChartDataMeta.description: Server-produced only, so every field is required (and non-optional in TypeScript).
ChartDataMeta.title: ChartDataMeta

ChartStatResponse.description: JSON body of /api/charts/data for plots that use a stat transform. Server-produced.
ChartStatResponse.title: ChartStatResponse

ColumnValues.description: Distinct values with counts, for filter dropdowns. Server-produced.
ColumnValues.title: ColumnValues

FieldSummary.description: One field within one group of a descriptive-statistics table. Server-produced.
FieldSummary.title: FieldSummary

ImportPreviewMeta.description: Arrow metadata of a preview response. Server-produced.
ImportPreviewMeta.title: ImportPreviewMeta

Job.description: Server-produced. Each SSE event carries a full snapshot.
Job.title: Job

OverlayResult.description: A server-computed trendline or regression fit, with an optional band. Server-produced.
OverlayResult.title: OverlayResult

PipelinePreviewMeta.description: Server-produced; travels as viz.meta in the Arrow schema.
PipelinePreviewMeta.title: PipelinePreviewMeta

ProjectImportResult.description: Server-produced only, so every field is required.
ProjectImportResult.title: ProjectImportResult

StagedFile.description: An uploaded file waiting to be previewed and imported. Server-produced.
StagedFile.title: StagedFile
